steps: Wash the rice and moong dal and soak them for 15 minutes.
Chop the carrot and beans very small; mince the chicken too if you are adding it.
Put the rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric, any chicken and about 300 ml water in a pressure cooker.
Cook for 3 to 4 whistles, then let the pressure drop on its own.
Heat the ghee in a small pan, add the cumin, let it crackle, then add a pinch of hing.
Pour this over the khichdi and mash it soft, adding hot water if it is too thick.
For egg, scramble it until fully set and stir it in; for paneer, crumble it in and warm it a minute.
Let it cool until just warm before serving.
note: No salt. Chicken is minced and cooked with the rice and dal so it turns soft; egg and paneer go in at the end.
